label: Inspect Mesh
description: Measure a 3D model (triangles, UVs, materials, textures, size) and check it against budgets. No AI involved: these are facts.

inputs.name: mesh
inputs.label: Mesh
inputs.description: The 3D model to inspect (.glb and .obj are measured in detail).

outputs.name: pass
outputs.label: Pass
outputs.description: The mesh, when it meets every enabled check.

outputs.name: fail
outputs.label: Fail
outputs.description: The mesh, when a check failed.

outputs.name: summary
outputs.label: Summary
outputs.description: Readable report. Feed it to an AI node or a Verify node as context.

outputs.name: texture
outputs.label: First Texture
outputs.description: The first texture image embedded in the mesh, as an image asset.

outputs.name: issues
outputs.label: Issues
outputs.description: Which checks failed, one per line.

outputs.name: error
outputs.label: Error
outputs.description: Error message if the step failed. Wire it to handle failures yourself; leave it unwired and the node fails visibly instead.
